claim: Source-adjudicated additional predictions on five public development repair clusters
limitations: Unique keys are case, side, file, line, and pattern ID; repeated predictions are correlated observations, not independent defects.
INVALID_LOCATION means the proposed pattern is not supported at that line, not necessarily that the file or line is absent.
NEEDS_CONTEXT remains unresolved and is neither a confirmed finding nor a false positive.
This is adjudication of additional predictions only; strict target hits and mapped AFTER alarms are recorded separately in results.json.
Public selected cases, single repetition, and manual source judgments do not establish population precision or a release-grade skill effect.
